title: Count Valid Parentheses
statement:
Given an integer N, count the number of valid combinations of N pairs of parentheses.

A string is a valid combination if every opening bracket has a corresponding closing bracket in the correct order.

This count equals the Nth Catalan number: C(2N, N) / (N + 1).
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of valid parentheses combinations with N pairs.
